title: Understanding the S Matrix
text: The matrix S contains the singular values of the dataset. These values are crucial for determining the variance captured by each principal component.

title: Variance and Singular Values
text: The singular values in the S matrix represent the square roots of the eigenvalues of the covariance matrix. The variance captured by each principal component is proportional to the square of these singular values.

title: Calculating Variance for Each Component
text: To find the variance captured by the second principal component, square the second singular value and divide it by the sum of the squares of all singular values.
